grammar: typescript
asserts: values, tql_tree, source_tree, bytecode

--- tql ---
def is_hook(@ident): @ident | text ~ /^use/;

. // identifier as @ident | is_hook(@ident)

--- source ---
function useFoo() {}
function bar() {}
